notes.title: Nine Realms: Revolt's soundtrack is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44271677/94d4c766360e596fbc6344575bdd72b0ee86748a.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone!

We’re happy to announce that Nine Realms: Revolt’s official soundtrack is here‼

It is composed by Sam Marks and Rory Chenoweth, the fantastic duo behind Epoch Music. Their combination of passion and skill helped us bring NRR to life.

Check the full soundtrack now on Spotify:
👉 https://open.spotify.com/intl-pt/album/23RD6EgmsIzjKIdQtKMTRW?si=Crv1a4BDSRCkB37PYhYAHQ

notes.title: DEMO ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that our newest game, Nine Realms: Revolt is coming soon!

It's an entirely new experience, in a completely different setting, and we cannot wait to see what you have to say about it!

This time, we're using Norse Mythology as inspiration, and telling a completely story-driven quest about peace, hatred, family, and learning to let go.

[b]Nine Realms: Revolt's Demo is set to release this Friday 23rd![/b]

We can't wait for you to play it!
